prompt: Which task is GitHub Mobile genuinely good for while commuting?
explanation: GitHub Mobile shines at review and triage — reading and merging pull requests, handling issues and notifications. Deep configuration editing and key management belong on a real machine.

options.text: Reviewing a pull request, leaving a comment, and merging it
Authoring a new dev container configuration
Debugging a failing workflow by editing its YAML inline
Generating a new SSH key pair for the laptop you left at home
